text:
Lia Parker: Heads-up — RiftBoard EAP handoff is scheduled for tomorrow morning. Partner asked for final NDA, benchmark config, and lab access window. Can we confirm who owns each piece? cc @Emily Chen :wave:
Emily Chen: I can own lab access and test-run coordination. I reserved the lab 09:00-11:00 PT. Need legal to sign off NDA edits by EOD today though.
LegalBot: NDA template v2 uploaded: https://redwood.share/nda/riftboard-v2.pdf. Note: partner requested removal of Section 3.2 (telemetry retention). We flagged it — need legal ack to proceed.
Lia Parker: Thanks. @LegalBot can you confirm whether we can accept their retention change or counter-propose a compromise? We need this done before sharing any bench numbers.
LegalBot: We can accept a limited retention change if we add audit-only access for Redwood. Proposed clause: "Redwood may retain telemetry for up to 90 days strictly for debugging and regressions." Uploaded diff in comments.
Rachel Ortiz: For the bench plan — proposing runs for: latency (p95/p99), steady-state throughput, memory/KV-cache profiling, and a 30-min stress soak. Models: redwood/base-7b, redwood/opt-13b, and a quantized 8-bit variant. Thoughts?
Sanjay Rao: Add a Bloom-1.7 variant and a tiny LLM for tiny-seq regression. Also include sequence-length sweep: 128, 512, 1024, 2048. Enable KV-cache profiling and perf counters.
Emily Chen: Partner replied — they can provide perf counters and thermal logs but will only share aggregated traces (no raw host metrics). They also asked we don't publish per-core clock rates.
Lia Parker: That's acceptable. We'll ask them for aggregated power/thermal + process-level CPU/GPU utilization. No public per-core numbers.
BenchBot: Scheduled benchmark job: 2026-05-17T16:00Z. Config attached.
BenchBot: ```
--models redwood/base-7b,redwood/opt-13b,bloom-1.7
--quantize 8bit
--batches 8,16
--seq_lengths 128,512,1024,2048
--profile kvcache,mem,power
--soak 1800s
```
Emily Chen: I'll validate infra/network reachability tonight (run a quick ssh + rdma test). If anyone has specific test scripts, drop them in the runbook here: https://redwood.share/runs/riftboard-eap-runbook.md
Sanjay Rao: Pushing a small kernel canary with latency microbenchmarks — ETA 4pm PT today. If canary is flaky, fallback to stock kernel build. Add a flag in the run config: `--use-optimized-kernel true/false`.
Lia Parker: Important: partner asked that we do not mention their name in any public communications until they approve release copy. Marketing hold. Also no joint announcement for at least 30 days post-run.
Rachel Ortiz: I'll make sure the perf dashboards redact partner identifiers and only show aggregate comparisons.
Emily Chen: Legal just DM'd — NDA tweak approved with the 90-day telemetry retention clause. I'll upload signed copy once countersign is complete.
Lia Parker: Great. Next steps: Emily will upload signed NDA and finalize lab access, Rachel will prepare dashboards with redaction, Sanjay will push the kernel canary, I will assemble the runbook and send partner the run schedule once NDA is in place.
Rachel Ortiz: Added a checklist to the runbook: preflight, perf counters list, logs to collect, expected deliverables. https://redwood.share/runs/checklist
Sanjay Rao: Noted. I'll include KV cache flame graphs and a short notes template for anomaly findings.
Lia Parker: Thanks everyone — if NDA is signed today I’ll send the schedule and invite. :thumbsup:
Emily Chen: I'll keep you posted. Partner asked for a quick sync after run to review findings — 30 minutes.
Lia Parker: Booked tentatively: 2026-05-18 17:00 PT for review. If anything changes ping here. :rocket:
